يستعذوا (form X)
# يَسْتَعْذُوا (yastaʕḏū) /jas.taʕ.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# يُسْتَعْذَوْا (yustaʕḏaw) /jus.taʕ.ðaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
